verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly offer a developer API with scoped keys, so this question applies to the product. The evidence shows only interactive sign-in through a single OHID credential account, and robots.txt returns 403 on both ohiosos.gov and the filing portal. Nothing documents issuing API credentials, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
